'''Shackle #74631''' was the broken shackle of [[Kaja Honn]], who was known on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] prison on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] as prisoner #74531. The shackle was an important artefact for [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]]s, and especially [[Clan Kaja]], who were created by Kaja Honn when she rallied the other prisoners who were imprisoned alongside her. Although Kaja herself died in an otherwise successful bid for freedom, the rest of her clan escaped and took this shackle with them. It was still in their possession when they gained full clan status some years later.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Mandalorian Relics: Shackle #74631}}</ref>
